name: Irises
selection: Design choices inspired by the linked reproduction as it appears today, not pigment measurements or exact pixel samples.

semantics.run: Keep filled-circle versus open-square encoding; do not encode replication with color alone.
semantics.protocol: Keep projective-Z and random-Pauli labels and existing panel assignments.
semantics.matrix: Keep both existing zero-centered scales, matrix order, signs, numeric annotations, and the existing reversed palette in the response matrix.
semantics.distance: Keep the zero reference line, accepted confidence intervals, and no exponential fit.
semantics.repository: Native GitHub Markdown. No custom page colors, fonts, CSS, or JavaScript.
semantics.paper: A neutral midpoint inside the matrix colormap, not a repository or figure-page background.
